explanation: Updated stripe.customers.retrieve to pass the API key inside a RequestOptions object ({ apiKey }) instead of as a plain string argument.
Updated listCustomers to use async/await when calling stripe.customers.list() instead of passing a callback.
Updated stripe.parseThinEvent to stripe.parseEventNotification following its rename in Stripe SDK v19.0.0.
Renamed usage_threshold_config to usage_threshold in stripe.billing.alerts.create to match the updated Stripe SDK v17.0.0 parameters.
Renamed volume_decimal to quantity_decimal in the fuel purchase details to comply with the Stripe SDK v16.0.0 update.
Renamed stripe.invoices.listUpcomingLineItems to stripe.invoices.listUpcomingLines to align with SDK v10.0.0 changes.
Replaced the removed retrieveDetails method with retrieve to fetch card details using the supported Stripe API method.
Updated stripe.checkoutSessions.create to stripe.checkout.sessions.create to reflect the resource being moved to the checkout namespace as sessions.
